login.title: The circle's side of Nora.
login.lede: Where everyone is, what's coming up, the game servers, and what she remembers about you. Sign in with the Discord account she already knows.
login.ledeWithCode: Where everyone is, what's coming up, the game servers, and what she remembers about you. Sign in with the Discord account she already knows, or a code she sends you on Signal or WhatsApp.
login.footnote: Only people Nora already knows can get in. Nobody else sees any of this.
login.deniedTitle: That Discord account isn't on the list.
login.deniedAs: You signed in as {name}. Ask Miles to add that account, or try another one.
login.deniedBody: Ask Miles to add it, or try another account.
login.deniedCodeTitle: You're not on the list any more.
login.deniedCodeBody: Your code sign-in was for someone Nora no longer lists. Ask Miles if that's a mistake.
login.signedOut: Signed out. Everything this device kept has been cleared.
login.error: Discord sign-in didn't finish. Try again.
login.codeTitle: Get a code on Signal or WhatsApp
login.codeLead: Nora messages you a six-digit code. No password.
login.phoneHint: The number Nora already knows you by. Not in the list? Type the whole number, starting with +.
login.codeSent: If {identifier} is on the list, Nora just sent a six-digit code to it on {platform}. It works for 5 minutes.
login.codeWrong: That code didn't work. It may be wrong, used or expired: check it, or ask for a new one.
login.codeInvalid: Type the number, or the six digits of the code.
login.codeUnavailable: Nora couldn't send a code just now. Try again in a minute, or use Discord.
login.codeSlow: That's a few codes in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.devBody: Only on a development server. Pick someone from the dev roster.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.whoBody: Nora is a private, non-commercial AI assistant. Her operator runs her for a small group of people who have been invited to use her. In this policy, "we" means the operator. You can contact us at {email}.
privacy.infoBody: Nora processes the following kinds of information:
privacy.infoMessages: Messages, media and voice in the group chats she has been added to, on the messaging platforms she supports.
privacy.infoShared: What members choose to share with her, such as questions, links, files and images.
privacy.infoConnected: Information from services and accounts she has been given access to, for example files shared with her account, which she reads with read-only access.
privacy.infoLocation: Location, only for members who choose to turn it on.
privacy.infoLogs: Technical logs and diagnostic traces produced while the service runs.
privacy.useBody: We use this information to let Nora respond in the conversation, to let her remember context for the group it came from, and to operate, maintain and troubleshoot the service.
privacy.processorsTitle: Services that process information for us
privacy.processorsBody: Information is handled by the following kinds of services, each under its own terms:
privacy.processorsModels: AI language model providers, which receive the conversation context needed to generate a reply.
privacy.processorsPlatforms: The messaging platforms Nora is used on, which carry the messages.
privacy.processorsHosting: The operator's own server, which hosts Nora and stores her data.
privacy.processorsConnected: Connected services, such as Google, which Nora accesses with read-only permissions where possible.
privacy.processorsTools: Other online services Nora uses to complete a request, such as web search or image generation, which receive what that request needs.
privacy.retentionBody: Information is kept while the service runs, or until you ask us to delete it. Diagnostic traces, which can include conversation content, are kept for troubleshooting. Messages also remain on the messaging platform under that platform's own terms.
privacy.choicesBody: You can leave a group chat that Nora is in, and she will no longer receive your messages there. You can ask us at {email} to delete your data. You can unshare a file to stop her opening it. Where you have given Nora access to an account or service, you can revoke that access in the service's settings at any time.
privacy.securityBody: Nora is self-hosted on a server the operator controls, and access to that server and its data is limited to the operator. No system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee the security of information sent over the internet.
privacy.neverBody: We do not sell your information, we do not use it for advertising, and we do not use it to train AI models.
privacy.googleBody: Nora has read-only access to Google Drive files that have been shared with her account. She opens a file only when someone asks her to, and she never creates, edits, deletes or shares files. Google user data is not used to create or edit images of people. Nora's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
privacy.googleLink: Google API Services User Data Policy
privacy.childrenBody: Nora is not directed at children under 13.
privacy.changesBody: If this policy changes, the updated version will be posted on this page with a new effective date.

terms.title: Terms
terms.acceptBody: By using Nora, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use her.
terms.serviceBody: Nora is a private, non-commercial AI assistant, available by invitation only. She is provided as is, without warranty of any kind. Her replies are generated by AI and may be inaccurate.
terms.useBody: Do not use Nora for anything unlawful, to harass anyone, or to try to misuse the accounts and services connected to her. Do not use her to generate sexual or non-consensual imagery of real people.
terms.contentBody: You are responsible for what you share with Nora. Share only what you have the right to share.
terms.availabilityBody: The service may change or stop at any time, without notice.
terms.liabilityBody: To the extent permitted by law, the operator is not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of Nora.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these terms can be sent to {email}.
